content:
deploy-bot: New RC created: rc-urgent-kvfix-0321
deploy-bot: repo=platform/serve, head=9b2d1f4, author=@olivia, artifacts=[serve:2026.03.21.kvfix], promo-window=2026-03-21T21:50Z..22:30Z
olivia: Created to address KV cache eviction that caused session 500s on long-running chat flows. tagging @mira (QA) @ash (oncall) @leo (PM). need quick decision on promo strategy.
sam: quick glance at changelog: also includes runtime kernel micro-bump (latency optimizations). that bump is minimal but could interact with kv timing. recommend canary.
mira: running quick smoke on staging now. we saw intermittent kv_get timeouts earlier; will report within 10m.
infra-bot: smoke-run queued: smoke-core @ rc-9b2d1f4 id=smoke-7564
ash: heads-up, if smoke fails we can either hold the RC or push a feature-flag guarded deploy. is the fix feature-flaggable?
olivia: not easily. fix touches eviction policy in core cache module. but we can do a traffic-tagged canary and also extend kv TTL on canary to reduce exposure.
sam: propose plan: 1) 5% canary with TTL-extension; 2) 20m hold and metrics check; 3) 30% then 100% if green. set alerts for 5xx spike > 50% over baseline or p95 latency >1.5x.
mira: smoke result: 2 failures in kv-warm tests earlier repro but rerun passed. logs: artifact 9b2d1f4/logs/smoke-7564. QA ready for canary.
leo: product preference: minimize customer visible 500s. can we do canary now and hold longer if signal noisy?
ash: scheduling canary: canary-tag=kvfix-canary; traffic=5% start; TTL-extension env var KV_TTL_MULTIPLIER=4 applied to canary. starting at 21:55Z.
mira: will run targeted acceptance against canary endpoints (kv_warm acceptance). reporting within 12m.
infra-bot: canary started: kvfix-canary-01 replicas=8 traffic=5%
sam: monitoring: p95 and 5xx dashboards linked: https://dash.internal/kvfix-rc-4787654321
mira: QA: acceptance passed on canary (kv_warm path), no 500s observed for 30m of session runs.
ash: increasing to 25% per plan. hold 15m.
leo: thumbs for full promo after 25% hold? :thumbsup:
olivia: +1 from me if metrics stable. also I'll draft release blurb for status page.
sam: metrics update after 25% hold: p95 +6%, 5xx stable. low error budget impact.
ash: promoting to 100% now. running rollout hook: rb promote rc-urgent-kvfix-0321 --to=prod --strategy=staged
infra-bot: promotion events: 25%->50%->100% completed.
ash: promotion complete: rc-urgent-kvfix-0321 -> prod; served artifacts: serve:2026.03.21.kvfix
ash: rollback snippet in case we see regression:
```
rb rollback rc-urgent-kvfix-0321 --target=serve:2026.03.19.stable
notify --channel=incidents --msg="Rollback executed: rc-urgent-kvfix-0321 -> serve:2026.03.19.stable"
```
leo: product note posted: "Mitigated intermittent session 500s by fixing KV cache eviction. Gradual rollout completed. Monitoring ongoing."
mira: post-promo quick QA sweep: no regressions in smoke or acceptance suites.
olivia: follow-ups: schedule 4-hour perf sweep overnight and add regression test to kv-warm suite. assigning to @sam and @mira.
sam: scheduled perf-sweep at 04:00Z. will monitor and update thread if anything shows up.
ash: RC closed and archived. changelog: https://internal.changelog/rc-urgent-kvfix-0321
